sources.snippet: BSC-LT/salamandra-7b-instruct - GGUF This repo contains GGUF format model files for BSC-LT/salamandra-7b-instruct . The files were quantized using machines provided by TensorBlock , and they are compatible with llama.cpp as of commit b4658 .
